description: This file defines two functions/macros for removing the first element from a list in CMake. The 'list_pop_front' function is a function that removes and returns the first element of a list, while the 'list_pop_front' macro provides a faster version of the same operation. The file appears to be a utility script used within a CMake build configuration to manipulate lists.

methods.name: list_pop_front
methods.description: Removes the first element from a list and returns it. Implements logic to handle empty lists and single-element lists.
